# The Bureau of Provisions

> A stainless steel bottle design with a folding steel straw, wide drinking spout and cooling mist. The first release is in development. Current design dimensions and nominal capacity are available; final production details and colours remain in development.

## Product

- [The bottle](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#ways): Seven interactive feature descriptions: mist, straw, spout, one continuous detachable carry strap with clip-on snap hooks, double-wall stainless steel dishwasher-safe cleaning and an inspirational message in braille.
- [Anatomy and specifications](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#specifications): An illustrative half-cutaway, material specifications and current design dimensions: 207.7 mm closed overall height, 185.4 mm body height and 65 mm body diameter. The 500 mL capacity is nominal design capacity, not a measured liquid volume.
- [Two-tone colour studies](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#colourways): A range of palettes and striped strap studies. Includes princess, football, space and superhero palette editions. Colours change only; the original bottle geometry and one continuous detachable carry strap with clip-on snap hooks are preserved.
- [Register to pre-order](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#colourways): Choose an edition and register interest through Tally. Pre-order price is £39 per bottle; ships internationally. Registration takes no payment; ordering details will follow.

- [Bottle questions](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#bottle-questions): Materials, dishwasher-safe cleaning, colour studies, price, international shipping and registration. Shipping charges and delivery dates have not yet been announced.

- [Contact the Bureau](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#contact): Investment enquiries and suggestions via a Tally contact form.
